conclusion: Independent read-only recomputation found no numerical, pairing, freshness, gate or cost error. The frozen decision discard_proposed_recipe is supported. The positive ranking point estimate does not establish an effect under its frozen interval gate; dense UNKNOWN and known false-abstention guards fail.

method.independence_unit: Five paired seeds with their own fresh train/dev worlds; queries and cells are dependent observations within a seed and are not treated as independent replications.
method.uncertainty_method: Two primary two-sided 97.5 percent paired-t intervals provide Bonferroni familywise 95 percent coverage. Descriptive secondary intervals are not additional confirmatory gates. Difference intervals are not clipped to probability bounds.
method.preservation: No existing source, result, preregistration, report, metric, threshold or history was changed by this review.

interpretation_limits: This is one visible synthetic-development replication with five paired units, not blinded final or transfer evidence.
Earlier selecting and failed studies remain separate and are not pooled into these intervals.
The ranking point estimate and five positive signs are encouraging descriptive evidence, but the frozen primary interval gate fails.
The result discards this exact recipe and does not falsify all hard-negative training or the architectural family.
Different quality and abstention outcomes prevent a claim of economic superiority from descriptive latency measurements.
The broader B transfer/prototype goal is not completed by this bounded MUC stage.
